title: PP1 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #15

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   C. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   D. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
   C. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   D. Say Eid has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Allah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in His and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. A — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Arabic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Belief in His; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
